2026-08-19 adversarial review round 3 on PR #3606 (four independent lenses: workflow semantics, backend endpoint, test sufficiency, security). Two HIGH findings fixed: 1) expectation now binds the subject run via required expected_run_id (schema field, digest field, verifier exact-match, build-time cross-check against business_smoke_ref) closing the cross-run evidence-replay hole; 2) the no-expectation branch of run_terminal_evidence now runs the same full status/state/verdict scan as run_terminal_success so contradictory failure signals anywhere in the payload fail closed. Three LOW findings fixed: close-sync rejects a passed-gate receipt whose top-level business_smoke_semantic key was stripped; the terminal-evidence projection rejects non-canonical schema keys and maps unserializable carriers to a typed 404 instead of a 500; tests gain a hardcoded expectation-digest anchor plus non-dict and run_id declaration rejection cases. Declined: whole-response byte bounding (carrier-section bound is the documented contract). Trust anchor documented: receipt integrity rests on git/PR review of the BUG-record diff (business_smoke_ref + expected_terminal_outcome).

expected: Runtime contract can explicitly declare an exact expected terminal outcome bound into contract and receipt digests; verifier passes only on exact match of status, previous status, reason code, and evidence carrier schema served by a bounded read-only evidence projection; missing declaration keeps strict fail-closed run_terminal_success semantics; close-sync rejects stale or mismatched expectation receipts.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
